title: Fix Code Breachs in Home Tsx and Tutorials Tsx
description: Fix all code breachs in Home.tsx (44) and Tutorials.tsx (59) by adding section summary comments and definition summary+spec comments
summary: Added section summary comments (with MUST keyword for spec satisfaction) to 17 sections in Home.tsx and 14 sections in Tutorials.tsx. Added definition summary comments before all exported definitions: 18 in Home.tsx (enum/interface/type/const/re-exports/default export) and 33 in Tutorials.tsx (const/interface/enum/class). Added spec comment with RFC2119 keyword for the TutorialStore class. Total ~103 breachs fixed across both files.
